resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Quotient[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

[b]Floor division[/b] is done using two forward slashes and is used to determine the [b]quotient [/b]of a division. Wait! What?! "Floor Division"? "Quotient"? 

Quotient just means the quantity produced by the division of two numbers. 

And Floor division is just like a normal division operation except that it returns the largest possible integer. This integer is either less than or equal to the normal division result.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="2847"]print( 20 // 6 ) [/code]
The code above will output 3, because 6 goes into 20 three times, and is the largest possible integer.
[note]You can also use floor division on floats, and the result will always be a float.[/note]

resolved.title: 商和余数
resolved.problem_statement_md:
请写程序计算出**888**分钟的对应的小时数。

请在两行中分别输出小时数、剩余分钟数。

例如，72分钟等于1小时12分钟，所以你的程序要输出：

```text
1
12
```
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Quotient & Remainder[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Random task! You need to calculate the number of hours in [b]888 [/b]minutes.

Your program needs to output the number of hours and then the number of remaining minutes, on separate lines.

For example, 72 minutes are equal to 1 hour and 12 minutes, so your program would output:
[b]1
12[/b]

[note]You can use [b]floor division[/b] to find the number of hours, and the [b]modulo[/b] operator to find the remaining minutes.
Use separate [b]print[/b]() statements for each output.[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
- 用**取整运算**求出小时数。
- 用**取余运算**求出剩余的分钟数。
- 每个输出使用单独的**print**()语句。
